_about: Homepage curation. build-lists.js reads this file. The homepage only shows clean, text-free crops made by scripts/make-home-images.py from the boxes below (box = [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the source image). Social/branded graphics with baked-in headlines are never used uncropped. Articles without a clean image here get a plain brand tile instead.

exclude._about: Stories never shown on the homepage (e.g. pre-launch pieces waiting for the accuracy-gate rewrite).

hero._about: Lead story: the newest Buyer's Brief that has a 'hero' banner in 'banners' below. Put a URL in 'pinned' to hold a chosen story instead (leave empty for automatic).

comparison._about: Comparison banner: the newest Comparison that has a 'compare' banner in 'banners'. 'pinned' holds a chosen one.

newUpcoming._about: Two cards: the newest story with a 'launch' banner and the newest with an 'upcoming' banner (see 'banners'). 'pinned' holds chosen stories. Until a kind has a banner, its card falls back to 'items' (the older split-card layout). Every line must come from the linked FlamingPiston story; say 'expected' unless the date is confirmed.

carCulture.title: Car Culture
carCulture.dek: Performance, design, innovation and the machines that define automotive history.
carCulture._about_image: The banner shows the newest story in data/car-culture.json that has a 'culture' banner (or 'pinned'); until one exists it uses 'image' below.

banners._about: Homepage banners, one per article, made for the layout (see docs/HOMEPAGE-BANNERS.md for sizes and prompt templates). kind: hero (2400x1000) | compare (2400x1000) | launch, upcoming (2400x800) | culture (3000x750). 'subject' = the car(s) bounding box [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions; the car must sit on the right with the left side dark and empty. compare also needs 'split' (x of the gap between the cars). launch/upcoming need 'status' (one dated line from the story). Optional: headline, dek, name, label, link, credit.

comparisons/tata-sierra-ev-vs-mahindra-b.headline: Sierra EV vs BE 6
comparisons/tata-sierra-ev-vs-mahindra-b.dek: Both are five-star Bharat NCAP cars that start ₹66,000 apart. Safety detail, price, range, charging and space, compared.
comparisons/tata-sierra-ev-vs-mahindra-b.credit: Images: Tata Motors and Mahindra, edited by FlamingPiston

images._about: Per article: 'hero' (exact 16:10 'box' for the lead story) and 'thumb' ('subject' = the car's bounding box; scripts/make-home-images.py frames it at every slot ratio). Optional 'area' keeps baked-in headlines out; 'erase' paints headline text off a plain studio wall.
